snippet.title: Game Trailer - Aqua Factory Simulator
snippet.description:
Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

Wishlist now on Steam.
